Misc. - 292/40
Wayside REGISTRY
385
Sept. 17th, 40.
Alleged Kidnapping of a male Chinese from Lane 226/26 Ward Road
by three persons, one believed to be a Japanese.
D.P.S. Arita, STRU of α

Sir,

At 4.40 p.m., 16-9-40, informant Loo Woo Sz (曾胡氏)
F/female, residing at House No.26 Ching Sing Li, Lane 226
Ward Road, came to the Station and reported that her hus-
band named Loo Siau Sai (曾小西), age 54, native of
Taushing, was kidnapped by three persons; whose descrip-
tion is as follows, from the above address at about 10.00
a.m., even date :-

(1) Male Chinese, age about 30, height about 5'5"
long face, fair complexion, short cropped hair
medium build, wearing white shirt and white
foreign style trousers, speaking Shanghai dia-
lect.

(2) Male Chinese, age about 28, height about 5'5"
square face, dark complexion, long hair parted
on the left side, medium build, wearing blue
cotton workman's clothing, speaking Shanghai
dialect.

(3) Age about 30, height about 5'4", long face,
dark complexion, shaved hair, medium build,
wearing a grey long gown, bearing the appear-
ance of a Japanese or a Cantonese, dialect
unknown.

Enquiries made by C.D.C.334 and the undersigned
ascertained that the informant's husband Loo Siau Sai is
the partner and concurrently accountant of the Foh Lee
Realty Company (福利地產公司), situated at Lane 226/26
Ward Road, where he resides together with his family.

At about 10.00 a.m., 16-9-40, the above three des-
cribed persons called on the above premises who were
admitted by the informant, the former two enquired if her
husband Loo Siau Sai was in, whereupon she replied that
he was lying sick on bed in the downstairs rear room.
The three intruders then entered the downstairs rear
room where Loo Siau Sai was found on a bed. The first

杂项 - 292/40
路边登记处
385
1940年9月17日。
据称一名中国男子在华德路226弄26号被三人绑架，其中一人疑似为日本人。
警务处副总监 Arita，STRU of α（原文不清）

先生：

1940年9月16日下午4时40分，报案人 Loo Woo Sz（曾胡氏），女性，居住于华德路226弄庆生里26号，来到警局报案称，其丈夫 Loo Siau Sai（曾小西），54岁，太仓籍，于同日约上午10时在上述地址被三人绑架；三人特征如下：

(1) 中国男性，年龄约30岁，身高约5英尺5英寸，长脸，肤色白皙，短发，中等身材，身穿白衬衫和白色西式长裤，讲上海话。

(2) 中国男性，年龄约28岁，身高约5英尺5英寸，方脸，肤色较深，长发向左分梳，中等身材，身穿蓝色棉质工装，讲上海话。

(3) 年龄约30岁，身高约5英尺4英寸，长脸，肤色较深，光头，中等身材，身穿灰色长衫，外貌看似日本人或广东人，方言不明。

经第334号刑事侦缉探员及本报告签署人调查查明，报案人之夫 Loo Siau Sai 系位于华德路226弄26号的福利地产公司（Foh Lee Realty Company）的合伙人兼会计，并与家人同住于此。

1940年9月16日上午10时许，上述三名特征之人前往上述住所，由报案人开门放入。前两人询问其丈夫 Loo Siau Sai 是否在家，报案人答称他正患病躺在楼下后屋的床上。随后这三名闯入者进入楼下后屋，发现 Loo Siau Sai 躺在床上。第一名

two described then asked Loo Siau Sai to get up from the
bed and go along with them stating that a friend of his
named Wong ( . . ) wished to have a talk with him. With-
out awaiting a reply from him they escorted him out of
the premises and placed him on one of two waiting public
ricshas, license number unknown, outside the premises,
the 1st described then also seated himself beside him on
the same ricsha whilst the 2nd and 3rd described seated
on the other one and then proceeded east along Ward Road.

During the above occurrence the informant was pre-
sent who enquired them who they were. The 1st and 2nd
described replied in Shanghai dialect that the 3rd des-
cribed was a Cantonese, but they did not give a compre-
hensive answer as to the reason of taking away her hus-
band. The informant stated that by his appearance the
3rd described was believed to be a Japanese, who through-
out the occurrence had remained silent without uttering
a word.

Questioned by detectives as to whether her husband
had any business dispute with others, the informant stated
that he was a very peaceful person and always in harmo-
nious terms with his friends and had never been in trouble
with his colleagues or friends regarding financial matters
She also stated that she has no idea whether her husband
has any friend by the name of Wong.

Up to the time of writing this report, no informa-
tion regarding the whereabouts of the informant's husband
was gleaned and the motive of the occurrence being unknown
however, efforts will be made to learn the identity of
pages.zh:
和第二名人随即要求 Loo Siau Sai 起床并随他们同行，声称他的一个名叫 Wong（..）的朋友想与他谈话。未待其回答，他们便将其带离住所，安置在门外等候的两辆公共人力车中的一辆上，车牌号码不详。第一名描述之人随后也坐在同一辆人力车上，紧挨着他，而第二和第三名描述之人则坐在另一辆车上，随后沿华德路向东行进。

在上述事件发生期间，报案人在场并询问他们是谁。第一和第二名描述之人用上海话回答说，第三名描述之人是广东人，但对于带走其丈夫的原因，他们并未给出全面答复。报案人称，从外貌看，她认为第三名描述之人是日本人，该人在整个过程中一直保持沉默，未发一言。

当侦探讯问其丈夫是否与他人有业务纠纷时，报案人称他为人非常平和，与朋友关系一直和睦，从未在财务问题上与同事或朋友发生过争执。她还表示，不知道其丈夫是否有名叫 Wong 的朋友。

截至撰写本报告时，尚未获取有关报案人丈夫下落的信息，事件动机亦不明。然而，我们将努力查明上述三名人员的身份，并寻找失踪人员 Loo Siru Sai（原文如此，应为 Loo Siau Sai）。

负责高级侦探 Egcarrison（音译）
1940年9月8日

“D”区副分区指挥官。
